places.n: Jazz Café Bossa, Tanukikōji (ジャズ喫茶 BOSSA)
places.w: A Tanukikōji jazz kissa open since 1971 whose owner's 15,000 records and CDs have carried Sapporo's jazz scene for half a century.

places.n: Miyoshino Tanukikōji (みよしの 狸小路店)
places.ad: Minami 3-jō Nishi 2-chōme 16-4 (Tanukikōji 2-chōme), Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Sapporo's own gyoza-and-curry chain — the cult combo plate of six dumplings beside a pool of curry rice.
places.nat: みよしの 狸小路店

places.n: Tanaka Shuzō Kikkōgura, Otaru (田中酒造 亀甲蔵)
places.w: An 1899 brewery in a stone warehouse that brews all four seasons thanks to Hokkaido's cool climate — walk the brewery, then taste free.

places.n: Niikuraya Hanazono Honten, Otaru (新倉屋 花園本店)
places.w: An 1895 wagashi house whose Hanazono dango wear their red-bean paste in a single mountain-shaped sweep.

places.n: California Baby, Hakodate (カリフォルニアベイビー)
places.ad: Bay area below Mt Hakodate (Motomachi side), Hakodate, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A diner in a converted Taishō-era post office that nearly every Hakodate local has eaten at — the Cisco rice was the owner's riff on chili beans from his time in America.
places.nat: カリフォルニアベイビー

places.n: Numa no Ya, Ōnuma (沼の家)
places.ad: Ōnuma, Nanae, Kameda District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Founded in 1905: unskewered dumplings laid in a box to echo the lakes and their ~126 islets, in bean paste and soy.

places.n: Hakodate Beer (はこだてビール)
places.w: The city's brewery restaurant on Kaikō-dōri — six regular beers on tap and a menu running from seafood to meat.

places.n: Hakodate Beer Hall, Kanemori (函館ビヤホール)
places.ad: Kanemori Red Brick Warehouse — Hakodate History Plaza, Hakodate, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A retro beer hall inside the Kanemori red-brick warehouses — two local beers, long sausage pie and potato-cheese bakes.

places.n: Robata Chidori, Rebun (炉ばた ちどり)
places.w: A Rebun robata where the local catch is miso-grilled at the hearth — the island's hokke chanchan-yaki is the order.

places.n: Kaisen Shokudō Kita no Gourmet-tei, Curb Market (海鮮食堂 北のグルメ亭)
places.ad: Sapporo Central Wholesale Market — Jōgai Shijō, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: The Curb Market's longest-running big canteen-cum-shop — its signature bowl lays twelve oversized toppings over rice.
places.nat: 海鮮食堂 北のグルメ亭

places.n: Marusan-tei, Curb Market (まるさん亭)
places.ad: Sapporo Central Wholesale Market — Jōgai Shijō, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Run by crab-and-seafood wholesaler Marusan Mikami Shōten — about eight seasonal toppings (tuna, uni, scallop, salmon) heaped on one bowl.

places.n: Kaisen-dokoro Uoya no Daidokoro, Nijō Market (海鮮処 魚屋の台所)
places.ad: Nijō Market, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A Nijō Market bowl shop opened by a long-time sushi chef to sell the freshest fish at fair prices — No. 2 in a MAPPLE readers' seafood ranking.
places.nat: 海鮮処 魚屋の台所

places.n: Wakasaimo Honpo Tōyako Honten (わかさいも本舗 洞爺湖本店)
places.ad: Tōyako Onsen 144, Tōyako, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: The lakeside flagship of Tōya's signature sweet, with the Sendō-an Japanese restaurant upstairs looking over the lake.
places.nat: わかさいも本舗 洞爺湖本店

places.n: Cranberry Honten, Obihiro (クランベリー 本店)
places.w: Obihiro's handmade-cake house, famous for its sweet-potato cake and for letting each ingredient's own flavour lead.
places.nat: クランベリー 本店

places.n: Masuya Shōten Honten, Obihiro (満寿屋商店 本店)
places.w: 'Masuya-san' — the 100%-Tokachi-wheat bakery with seven shops in the region; the main store keeps the sweet, soft breads first baked as farmhands' snacks.

places.n: Satō Shokudō, Rishiri (さとう食堂)
places.ad: In front of the ferry terminal, Rishiri Island, Rishiri District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: The long-running ferry-front canteen for Rishiri sea urchin over rice, grilled hokke sets and kelp ramen — open with the ferry season.

places.n: Michi-no-eki Mukawa Shiki no Yakata (道の駅 むかわ四季の館)
places.w: The roadside station of Japan's shishamo town — its Tanpopo dining room serves the local smelt in season.
places.nat: 道の駅 むかわ四季の館

places.n: Michi-no-eki Sarufutsu Kōen (道の駅 さるふつ公園)
places.w: On the Okhotsk coast of Japan's scallop capital — scallop curry in the restaurant and the station's own scallop-rice bento.
places.nat: 道の駅 さるふつ公園

places.n: Michi-no-eki Shikabe Kanketsusen Kōen (道の駅 しかべ間歇泉公園)
places.w: A roadside station built around a geyser that blows about 15 m every 10–15 minutes — buy seafood and vegetables and steam them yourself in the hot-spring steam, then Shikabe cod roe at the Hama no Kaa-san canteen.
places.nat: 道の駅 しかべ間歇泉公園

places.n: Michi-no-eki Pia 21 Shihoro (道の駅 ピア21しほろ)
places.w: The barn-roofed food hub of a beef-and-potato town — the Nijiiro Shokudō serves Shihoro beef steak with the town's vegetables.
places.nat: 道の駅 ピア21しほろ

places.n: Michi-no-eki 230 Rusutsu (道の駅 230ルスツ)
places.ad: Route 230, Rusutsu, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Rusutsu growers' farm stand on Route 230 — asparagus, corn and tomatoes picked that morning in high season, and a pizza counter visitors detour for.

places.n: Michi-no-eki Makkari Flower Center (道の駅 真狩フラワーセンター)
places.w: Makkari grows about 60% of Japan's edible lily bulbs — the station sells them fresh and baked into monaka and castella, under Mt Yōtei.
places.nat: 道の駅 真狩フラワーセンター

places.n: Michi-no-eki Nanairo Nanae (道の駅 なないろ・ななえ)
places.w: Nanae's food-and-history station, in the birthplace of Western-style farming in Japan — guaraná soft-serve from the local soda maker and croquettes of Yamakawa ranch beef.
places.nat: 道の駅 なないろ・ななえ

places.n: Michi-no-eki Ryūhyō Kaidō Abashiri (道の駅 流氷街道網走)
places.w: Abashiri's roadside station — the Kinema-kan food court does local-only dishes like the pink-salmon-and-yam Abashiri burger.
places.nat: 道の駅 流氷街道網走

places.n: Michi-no-eki Mashū Onsen (道の駅 摩周温泉)
places.w: The Teshikaga stop for Lake Mashū — Ezo-deer burgers and local dairy ice cream alongside the area's produce.

places.n: Hakodate Asaichi Ekini Ichiba (函館朝市 えきに市場)
places.ad: Hakodate Morning Market, by JR Hakodate Station, Hakodate, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: The Morning Market hall with the squid-fishing tank — hook a live squid and the stallholder slices it into translucent sashimi with ginger soy at the table.
places.nat: 函館朝市 えきに市場

places.n: Hakodate Kaisen Ichiba Honten (はこだて海鮮市場 本店)
places.w: A big Bay-area seafood market of crab, squid and roe for tasting and shipping home.
places.nat: はこだて海鮮市場 本店

places.n: Michi-no-eki Utonai-ko (道の駅 ウトナイ湖)
places.ad: Beside Lake Utonai, Tomakomai, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Beside Lake Utonai — a farm-and-fish shop and restaurant serving Tomakomai's hokki curry and the city's half-century-old miso-curry ramen.
places.nat: 道の駅 ウトナイ湖

places.n: Michi-no-eki Biei Shirogane Birke (道の駅 びえい「白金ビルケ」)
places.ad: Shirogane, Biei, Kamikawa District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A birch-wood station at the Blue Pond gateway — burgers on Biei-wheat buns with premium patties, a bakery and Blue-Pond-themed treats.
places.nat: 道の駅 びえい「白金ビルケ」

places.n: Michi-no-eki Mochigome no Sato ☆ Nayoro (道の駅 もち米の里☆なよろ)
places.w: Nayoro's rice-country station — its own fluffy 'soft daifuku', made from local mochi rice in some eighteen flavours.
places.nat: 道の駅 もち米の里☆なよろ

places.n: Curry Shop S, Susukino (カレーショップ S)
places.ad: Silver Bldg B1F, Minami 3-jō Nishi 4-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A basement soup-curry counter in the middle of Susukino, on both the city tourism board's and GoodLuckTrip's Susukino lists.

places.n: Night Parfait Nanakamado (夜パフェ専門店 ななかまど)
places.ad: Dai-4 Fujii Bldg 2F, Minami 4-jō Nishi 5-10, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A dedicated night-parfait bar in Susukino — the after-dinner, after-drinks parfait until late.
places.nat: 夜パフェ専門店 ななかまど

places.n: Parfaiteria PaL (パフェテリア パル)
places.w: A second night-parfait specialist in Susukino, open every night of the year until midnight or later.
places.nat: パフェテリア パル

places.n: Rokkatei Sapporo Honten (六花亭 札幌本店)
places.ad: 5 minutes' walk from JR Sapporo Station (south exit), Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Tokachi confectioner Rokkatei's Sapporo flagship — the shop below, and a café above serving store-only desserts; home of the Marusei Butter Sand (white chocolate, raisins, Hokkaido butter).

places.n: Kinotoya Ōdōri Kōen & KINOTOYA Café (きのとや 大通公園店)
places.ad: Ōdōri Kōen area, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Sapporo patissier Kinotoya's Ōdōri café — the fresh, silky milk soft-serve that topped New Chitose Airport's ice-cream election two years running.
places.nat: きのとや 大通公園店

places.n: Ōdōri BISSE (大通ビッセ)
places.ad: Directly connected to Ōdōri subway station, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A station-linked complex whose ground floor gathers famous Hokkaido confectioners and farm-milk soft-serve and gelato counters.

places.n: Michi-no-eki Space Apple Yoichi (道の駅 スペース・アップルよいち)
places.w: Yoichi's roadside station in apple country — orchard juice, house-made ice cream and apple pie from local fruit.
places.nat: 道の駅 スペース・アップルよいち

places.n: Michi-no-eki Misogi no Sato Kikonai (道の駅 みそぎの郷 きこない)
places.ad: At JR Kikonai Station (Hokkaido Shinkansen), Kikonai, Kamiiso District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: The roadside station at the first Hokkaido Shinkansen stop — sweets and bread built on the salt of Kikonai's midwinter Kanchū Misogi festival, and the town's own sake.
places.nat: 道の駅 みそぎの郷 きこない

places.n: Kushiro Rāmen Maruhira (釧路ラーメン まるひら)
places.w: A 60-plus-year Kushiro counter with a two-item menu, shōyu or shio, open mornings to early afternoon — No. 66 in Ramen Adventures' Hokkaido top 100.
places.nat: 釧路ラーメン まるひら

places.n: Kama-ei Factory Store, Otaru (かま栄 工場直売店)
places.w: Otaru's kamaboko house since 1905 — the pan-roll is, sold only here because it can't be shipped; café on site.
places.nat: かま栄 工場直売店

places.n: Kitaichi Hall, Otaru (北一ホール)
places.ad: Kitaichi Glass No. 3 building, Sakaimachi 7-26, Otaru, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: The café in Kitaichi Glass's Meiji stone warehouse, lit by 167 oil lamps that staff light one by one after the 9am opening.

places.n: Sushi-dokoro Kihara, Yunokawa (鮨処 木はら)
places.ad: Yunokawa Onsen area, Hakodate, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A Yunokawa sushi counter whose chef grew up in a fishing family and buys the day's best catch — serious sushi without ceremony.

places.n: Ajanta Yakuzen Curry Honpo Sōhonke (アジャンタ薬膳カリィ本舗総本家)
places.ad: Kita 23-jō Higashi 20-2-18, Higashi-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Ajanta's 1970s medicinal curry is where Sapporo soup curry began; this is the head shop.
places.nat: アジャンタ薬膳カリィ本舗総本家

places.n: Chitose-tsuru Sake Museum (千歳鶴 酒ミュージアム)
places.ad: Minami 3-jō Higashi 5-1, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: The shop and small museum of Sapporo's only sake brewery (Nihon Seishu), with free tasting counter and brewery-only bottles.
places.nat: 千歳鶴 酒ミュージアム

places.n: Snow Brand Parlor Sapporo Honten (雪印パーラー 札幌本店)
places.ad: Taiyō Seimei Sapporo Bldg 1F, Kita 2-jō Nishi 3-1-31, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Sapporo's 1961 dairy parlour: 30-plus parfaits and the 'Snow Royal' ice cream first made for a 1968 imperial visit.
places.nat: 雪印パーラー 札幌本店

places.n: Sapporo Senshūan Honten (札幌千秋庵 本店)
places.ad: Minami 3-jō Nishi 3, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Confectioner since 1921, maker of the Northman bean-paste pie and Yama-oyaji biscuits.

places.n: Do Ermitage, Susukino (ドゥ・エルミタアヂュ)
places.ad: Minami 3-jō Nishi 4 Bldg 10F, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: An old-school authentic bar run by a woman with about 50 years behind the counter; more than 400 whiskies.
places.nat: ドゥ・エルミタアヂュ

places.n: Jingisukan Yōyōtei Sapporo Honten (ジンギスカン羊々亭 札幌本店)
places.w: Specialist lamb grill known for its rare 'Roaring Forties' lamb.
places.nat: ジンギスカン羊々亭 札幌本店

places.n: Nama-Ramu Jingisukan Yamagoya, Susukino (生ラムジンギスカン 山小屋)
places.ad: Dai-5 Green Bldg 1F, Minami 4-jō Nishi 4-13-2, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Susukino fresh-lamb grill carrying on the 1956 sauce of Otaru's Keishōen.
places.nat: 生ラムジンギスカン 山小屋

places.n: Beer Bar North Island (ビアバー ノースアイランド)
places.ad: Large Country Bldg 10F, Minami 2-jō Nishi 4-10-1, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Taproom of Sapporo's North Island Beer (founded 2003, now brewed in Ebetsu) — fresh kegs, guest and seasonal beers.
places.nat: ビアバー ノースアイランド

places.n: Misoramen Senmonten Ōkami Soup (味噌らーめん専門店 狼スープ)
places.ad: Near Nakajima Park, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Started as a yatai in 2000 and reopened in 2012; it serves miso ramen only.
places.nat: 味噌らーめん専門店 狼スープ

places.n: Soba-ya Yabuhan, Otaru (蕎麦屋 籔半)
places.w: A 1954 Edo-style soba house near Otaru Station.

places.n: Ice Cream Parlor Misono, Otaru (アイスクリームパーラー美園)
places.w: Opened in 1919 as the first shop in Hokkaido to sell ice cream, and still uses its original method.
places.nat: アイスクリームパーラー美園

places.n: Uomasa, Otaru (魚真)
places.w: Local-catch sushi at fair prices, as popular with residents as with visitors.

places.n: Otaru Milk Plant (小樽ミルクプラント)
places.w: Otaru's oldest soft-serve stand, run by Hoshō Gyūnyū in its 1936 milk-plant office.

places.n: Taishō Glass Kuboya, Sakaimachi (大正硝子 くぼ家)
places.w: A kissaten in the historic former Sakaiya shop on Sakaimachi Street, kept going by Taishō Glass.

places.n: Kita no Donburiya Takinami Shokudō, Sankaku Market (北のどんぶり屋 滝波食堂)
places.ad: Sankaku Market, Inaho 3-10-16, Otaru, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: The Takinami fish shop's diner in the Triangle Market — seafood from the tanks onto a pick-your-own bowl, with a queue every day.
places.nat: 北のどんぶり屋 滝波食堂

places.n: New Sankō, Otaru (ニュー三幸)
places.ad: Sun Mall 1-bangai, Inaho 1-3-6, Otaru, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A 1954 all-round restaurant, now known for its ankake yakisoba on house egg noodles. Bunkacho has named the dish a '100-Year Food'.

places.n: Hakodate Wine Budōkan Honten (はこだてわいん 葡萄館本店)
places.ad: Kamifujishiro 11, Nanae, Kameda District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: One of Hokkaido's pioneer wineries (1973): about 80 wines on the shelves, a dozen to taste free, and a wine soft-serve sold only here.
places.nat: はこだてわいん 葡萄館本店

places.n: Michi-no-eki YOU・Yū・Mori (道の駅 YOU・遊・もり)
places.ad: Kamidai-chō 326-18, Mori, Kayabe District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Route 5 roadside station of Mori, home of ikameshi — the squid-rice ekiben sold here in many forms, with Komagatake and Uchiura Bay from the roof lounge.
places.nat: 道の駅 YOU・遊・もり

places.n: Michi-no-eki Kitamaebune Matsumae (道の駅 北前船 松前)
places.w: Clifftop roadside station on the Tsugaru Strait serving bowls of wild bluefin from the same waters as Ōma tuna, and Matsumae-zuke, the clan-era pickle of herring roe, kelp and squid.
places.nat: 道の駅 北前船 松前

places.n: Michi-no-eki Kaminokuni Monju (道の駅 上ノ国もんじゅ)
places.w: Sea-of-Japan roadside station whose restaurant window looks over the water; the signature is a tendon of local flounder.
places.nat: 道の駅 上ノ国もんじゅ

places.n: Yakitori Senmon Ginneko (焼鳥専門 ぎんねこ)
places.w: The keeper of Asahikawa's soul food: a 1925 yakitori house in the Fura-Ri-To alley grilling a whole half chicken over charcoal in its never-emptied tare.
places.nat: 焼鳥専門 ぎんねこ

places.n: Taisetsu Ji-Beer-kan (大雪地ビール館)
places.w: A red-brick warehouse brewpub five minutes from Asahikawa Station pouring the local Taisetsu beers alongside fresh-lamb jingisukan.

places.n: Furano Marché (フラノマルシェ)
places.w: Four buildings round a plaza near Furano Station: JA Furano's farm shop, a sweets bakery, ~2,000 local products and takeout stands cooking local ingredients.

places.n: Goshōteya Honpo, Esashi (五勝手屋本舗)
places.ad: Honchō 38, Esashi, Hiyama District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Esashi's 1870 confectioner, whose cylindrical azuki yōkan — sliced with the string on the tube — was presented to the Shōwa Emperor in 1936.

places.n: Kasshō Ryōri Ikasei Honten (活魚料理 いか清 本店)
places.w: Goryōkaku-side live-seafood house built around Hakodate's squid: the tank-fresh ma-ika is cut to order as glassy ikasōmen-style sashimi.
places.nat: 活魚料理 いか清 本店

places.n: Shōga Rāmen Mizuno, Asahikawa (生姜ラーメン みづの)
places.w: Asahikawa's ginger-ramen original, invented by the founder in 1972 — a shōyu bowl sharpened with grated ginger.
places.nat: 生姜ラーメン みづの

places.n: Michi-no-eki Biei 'Oka no Kura' — Kōbaku Shokudō (道の駅 びえい「丘のくら」香麦食堂)
places.w: Stone-warehouse roadside station in central Biei whose dining room serves the town's curry udon both baked and as a dip, heaped with local vegetables.
places.nat: 道の駅 びえい「丘のくら」香麦食堂

places.n: Michi-no-eki Salmon Park Chitose (道の駅 サーモンパーク千歳)
places.w: Chitose's salmon-river roadside station beside the Chitose Aquarium and its Indian water-wheel — a six-stall food court built around salmon.
places.nat: 道の駅 サーモンパーク千歳

places.n: Umi no Eki Platto Minato Ichiba, Tomakomai (海の駅 ぷらっとみなと市場)
places.w: Tomakomai port's market hall — Japan's top hokki-clam catch sold fresh, eaten in hokki-don and hokki curry at the stalls, with a small hokki museum.
places.nat: 海の駅 ぷらっとみなと市場

places.n: Michi-no-eki Date Rekishi no Mori (道の駅 だて歴史の杜)
places.w: Date's roadside station in its history park — Hansamu Shokudō, the scallop takikomi-gohan 'Date-musha' bento and Makiya's Date-milk pudding.
places.nat: 道の駅 だて歴史の杜

places.n: Michi-no-eki Tōya-ko (道の駅 とうや湖)
places.w: Hill-top roadside station above Lake Tōya with Mt Yōtei views; its shokudō and takeaway counter work the farm produce of the caldera rim.

places.n: Michi-no-eki Shiretoko-Rausu (道の駅 知床・らうす)
places.ad: Hon-chō, Rausu, Menashi District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: The roadside station closest to Kunashir — its Shiretoko Shokudō is the local name for Rausu-landed hokke and kinki teishoku.
places.nat: 道の駅 知床・らうす

places.n: Michi-no-eki Swan 44 Nemuro (道の駅 スワン44ねむろ)
places.w: On Lake Fūren's swan shore — the Bird Pal dining room looks over the lagoon and is known for Nemuro's hanasaki-crab ramen.
places.nat: 道の駅 スワン44ねむろ

places.n: Michi-no-eki Akan Tanchō no Sato (道の駅 阿寒丹頂の里)
places.w: Akan's crane-country roadside station (with an onsen) — Restaurant Tsuru grills local Ezo-shika venison.
places.nat: 道の駅 阿寒丹頂の里

places.n: Hanabatake Bokujō, Nakasatsunai (花畑牧場)
places.ad: Moto-Satsunai Higashi 4-sen 311-6, Nakasatsunai, Kasai District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Tanaka Yoshitaka's showcase ranch, birthplace of the nama-caramel boom — the café serves its own-cheese dishes and sweets.

places.n: Isoyakitei, Rishiri (磯焼亭)
places.ad: Oshidomari, Rishirifuji, Rishiri District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Opposite Oshidomari ferry terminal — Rishiri's raw bafun-uni bowls (Apr-Oct) and kombu-broth Rishiri ramen.

places.n: Karafuto Shokudō, Wakkanai (樺太食堂)
places.w: Seasonal fishermen-direct uni-don shack by Cape Noshappu, made famous by touring riders.

places.n: Sukiyaki Asari Honten, Hakodate (阿佐利 本店)
places.w: A 1901 beef shop turned sukiyaki specialist in an early-Shōwa building — black wagyu at fair prices, a limited weekday lunch, and croquettes from the ground-floor butcher.

places.n: Ame wa, Yasashiku No.2 (雨は、やさしくNo.2)
places.ad: Kita 7-jō Higashi 3-chōme, Higashi-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A creative Sapporo shop whose signature bowl comes with a scallop paste you stir in as you eat. rurubu's 2025 list of local favourites includes it.

places.n: Hachinoki (八乃木)
places.w: Keeps the traditional Sapporo miso style while developing its own. One of rurubu's seven classic miso shops for 2025, and new on Ramen Adventures' Hokkaido list at #15.

places.n: Sapporo Menya Mitsubaki (札幌麺屋 美椿)
places.w: A noren-wake offshoot of a famous Sapporo shop; its miso ramen layers miso, stock and wok-fried vegetables. On rurubu's classic-seven list, and a new entry at #19 on Ramen Adventures' 2024 Hokkaido list.

places.n: Sapporo Bon no Kaze (札幌 凡の風)
places.ad: Minami 8-jō Nishi 15-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Serves two signature bowls: a clean tanrei shōyu and a modern miso. On rurubu's 2025 local-favourites list, and new on Ramen Adventures' 2024 Hokkaido list at #21.

places.n: Ramen Tetsuya Minami 7-jō Honten (らーめん てつや 南7条本店)
places.ad: Minami 7-jō Nishi 12-chōme 2-19, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: The Sapporo shop that brought rich back-fat tonkotsu shōyu to a miso city; the head branch is in southern Chuo-ku.
places.nat: らーめん てつや 南7条本店

places.n: Shiawase no Recipe ~Sweet~ Susukino (幸せのレシピ～スイート～ すすきの店)
places.ad: Big Silver Bldg B1F, Minami 3-jō Nishi 4-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A late-night parfait basement in central Susukino, open until about 2 am: seasonal parfaits built on more than 20 house-made gelato.
places.nat: 幸せのレシピ～スイート～ すすきの店

places.n: Kaiten-zushi Nemuro Hanamaru, JR Tower Stellar Place (回転寿司 根室花まる JRタワーステラプレイス店)
places.ad: Sapporo Stellar Place Center 6F, Kita 5-jō Nishi 2-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Sapporo Station branch of the Nemuro conveyor-belt chain, with fish shipped direct from Nemuro. Locals rank it among the city's best kaiten-zushi, and the queues are long.
places.nat: 回転寿司 根室花まる JRタワーステラプレイス店

places.n: Soup Curry TREASURE (スープカレー トレジャー)
places.ad: Asuka Bldg 1F, Minami 2-jō Nishi 1-chōme 8-2, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan 〒060-0062
places.w: Sister shop of GARAKU. Its soup curry uses a Japanese stock made from eight kinds of dried fish flakes, finished with a secret paste of minced pork and spices. Three minutes' walk from Ōdōri Station.
places.nat: スープカレー トレジャー

places.n: Kotobuki Coffee, M's Nijō Yokochō (寿珈琲)
places.ad: M's Nijō Yokochō 1F, Minami 2-jō Higashi 1-chōme 1-6, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A retro coffee house next to Nijō Market that roasts its own beans. The room keeps its Meiji-era Sapporo soft-stone and red-brick walls, and it stays open until midnight on weekdays.

places.n: Villa Lupicia Restaurant, Kabayama (ヴィラ ルピシア レストラン)
places.ad: Kabayama 58-5, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Tea house Lupicia's glass-walled restaurant in Hirafu-Kabayama, serving modern European cooking with a Japanese touch and its own Yōtei-foothills beer, poured at a summer beer garden too.
places.nat: ヴィラ ルピシア レストラン

places.n: Michi-no-eki Rankoshi Furusato-no-Oka (道の駅 らんこし・ふるさとの丘)
places.ad: Aioi 969, Rankoshi, Isoya District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Route 5 roadside station of Rankoshi, a town known for its rice, selling Shiribetsu-valley produce and house pickles with views of the Niseko range and Yōtei.
s: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/道の駅らんこし・ふるさとの丘
places.nat: 道の駅 らんこし・ふるさとの丘

places.n: Restaurant Makkarina, Makkari (レストラン マッカリーナ)
places.ad: Midorioka 172-3, Makkari, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: Auberge restaurant in the Makkari woods at the foot of Yōtei, cooking French from the village's own fields and mountain spring water under chef Sugaya Shin'ichi's direction.
places.nat: レストラン マッカリーナ

places.n: Otaru Nihonbashi, Sushiya-dōri (小樽 日本橋)
places.w: One of the five houses of the Sushiya-dōri Meitenkai (the street's founding sushi guild), three minutes from the canal: counter, private rooms and seasonal Otaru nigiri.

places.n: Rinyū Asaichi Morning Market, Otaru (鱗友朝市)
places.w: The locals' fish market by the port, open from 4 a.m.: a dozen stalls of fresh fish, dried and salted catch, plus a diner for breakfast seafood bowls (closed Sundays).

places.n: Otaru Denuki Kōji (小樽出抜小路)
places.w: A retro food alley opposite the canal recreating Otaru's Meiji–Taishō merchant streets, with over twenty small eateries serving Japanese, Western and Chinese dishes from local seafood.

places.n: Tomita Melon House, Nakafurano (とみたメロンハウス)
places.ad: Miya-machi 3-32, Nakafurano, Sorachi District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A melon grower's shop and deck café facing the Tokachi range, near the lavender farms — cut Furano melon, melon soft-serve and melon-only sweets. Summer season only (Jun–Sep).

places.n: Michi-no-eki Otofuke Natsuzora no Furusato (道の駅 おとふけ なつぞらのふる里)
places.w: Rebuilt and reopened in April 2022 as one of Hokkaido's biggest roadside stations, with a 'Natsuzora' (NHK drama) zone and a food court of Tokachi soul food — butadon, local-wheat bakeries and dairy.
places.nat: 道の駅 おとふけ なつぞらのふる里

places.n: Tsuboya Kibana no Mori, Asahikawa (壺屋 き花の杜)
places.w: Asahikawa's century-old confectioner Tsuboya in a brick-and-timber shop set in a 1,000-tsubo garden: its standards and shop-only sweets, a viewable kibana production line, and the Café Bunran tea room.

places.n: Campana Rokkatei, Furano (カンパーナ六花亭)
places.w: Rokkatei's Furano store on Shimizuyama: a glass hall in 24,000 tsubo of vines with the Furano basin and Daisetsu range beyond; the tea room serves the shop-exclusive Furano mochi.

places.n: Tokachi Shinmura Bokujō, Kamishihoro (十勝しんむら牧場)
places.w: A grazing dairy north of Obihiro famous across Japan for its milk jam; the farm's tea room serves it on waffles and soft-serve. Open Apr–Dec.

places.n: Hakodate Men'ya Ichimonji, Yunokawa (函館麺や 一文字)
places.w: Yunokawa's shio-ramen specialist — a double soup of whole chicken and Minami-kayabe kombu, clam and shijimi essence in the salt tare, and its own thin straight noodles.

places.n: Tearoom Victorian Rose, Former British Consulate (ティールーム ヴィクトリアンローズ)
places.w: The English tearoom inside the 1913 Former British Consulate — antiques shipped from Britain, scones and a full afternoon-tea stand in Motomachi.
places.nat: ティールーム ヴィクトリアンローズ

places.n: Indo Curry Koike Honten, Hakodate (印度カレー 小いけ本店)
places.w: Founded 1948, Hakodate's old-school curry house — a sharply spiced, nostalgic roux that locals rank beside Gotōken's.
places.nat: 印度カレー 小いけ本店

places.n: Hakodate Jiyū Ichiba (はこだて自由市場)
places.w: The locals' and chefs' market rather than the tourists' — sushi chefs buy here; fish stalls will slice what you pick, plus a shokudō and food court.

places.n: Donburi Yokochō Ichiba, Hakodate Morning Market (どんぶり横丁市場)
places.ad: Wakamatsu-chō, Hakodate, Hokkaido, Japan (inside Hakodate Morning Market)
places.w: The Morning Market's canteen arcade — a covered lane of donburi shokudō open from dawn into lunch, the place for kaisendon by Hakodate Station.

places.n: Chikurōen Azumaya Sōhonten, Kushiro (竹老園 東家総本店)
places.w: Meiji-founded soba house in a 1927 building with a Japanese garden — the origin of Kushiro's green-tinged soba, served as ranchiri, kashiwa-nuki and soba-zushi.
places.nat: 竹老園 東家総本店

places.n: Okhotsk Beer Factory, Kitami (オホーツクビアファクトリー)
places.w: The brewpub that started Hokkaido's craft-beer boom — all-malt pilsner and ales brewed on site in Kitami, with a restaurant.
places.nat: オホーツクビアファクトリー

places.n: Graubünden, Hirafu (おやつとサンドイッチのお店 グラウビュンデン)
places.ad: Niseko Hirafu 5-jō 4-chōme 2-6, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
places.w: A sweets-and-sandwich café in Hirafu village known for its house sandwiches and seasonal-fruit cakes; listed in Kutchan's official town specialty catalogue.
places.nat: おやつとサンドイッチのお店 グラウビュンデン
